SubHorzPosBnk3.name: Sprite to Mario horizontal distance
summary: Bank 3 copy of SubHorzPos.
Returns: Y = 0 if Mario is at or right of the sprite, 1 if left; [$0F] = low byte of Mario X - sprite X.

SubVertPosBnk3.name: Sprite to Mario vertical distance
summary: Bank 3 copy of SubVertPos.
Returns: Y = 0 if Mario is at or below the sprite, 1 if above; [$0F] = low byte of Mario Y - sprite Y.

s03B83B.name: Table: off-screen despawn limits
summary: Vertical (2 entries) and horizontal (4 pairs) limits used by the SubOffscreen routines, as 16-bit offsets from the screen boundary, low and high bytes in separate tables.

SubOffscreen3Bnk3.name: Despawn off-screen sprite, margin set 3
summary: Entry point that selects the widest margin set ([$03] = 6) and joins SubOffscreen0Bnk3.

SubOffscreen2Bnk3.name: Despawn off-screen sprite, margin set 2
summary: Entry point that sets [$03] = 4 and joins the shared code.

SubOffscreen1Bnk3.name: Despawn off-screen sprite, margin set 1
summary: Entry point that sets [$03] = 2 and joins the shared code.

SubOffscreen0Bnk3.name: Despawn off-screen sprite (horizontal)
summary: Bank 3 copy of SubOffscreen. Called by sprites every frame to remove themselves when too far from the screen.
Does nothing while the sprite is on screen or has the process-off-screen tweaker bit set (except falling below the level).
Otherwise alternates frames between the right and the left limit and erases the sprite once beyond it.
Parameters: X = sprite index; entry point picks the margin set in [$03] (0, 2, 4, 6). Vertical levels use VerticalLevelBnk3.

OffScrEraseSprBnk3.name: Erase sprite, allow level reload
summary: Clears the sprite status. If the sprite came from the level's sprite list (and was alive, status >= 8) its load status is cleared too, so it respawns when its position scrolls back.

OffScrKillSprBnk3.name: Erase sprite
summary: Sets sprite status to 0 and returns.

VerticalLevelBnk3.name: Despawn off-screen sprite (vertical level)
summary: Vertical level version of the off-screen check: runs every other frame, alternates between the bottom and the top limit, and jumps to OffScrEraseSprBnk3 when beyond it.

IsSprOffScreenBnk3.name: Is sprite off-screen
summary: Returns: A = 0 if on screen, non-zero if off-screen horizontally or vertically.

MagiKoopaPals.name: Palette data: Magikoopa fade steps
summary: 8 steps of 16 bytes (8 colors, BGR555). Copied to the palette upload buffer by the sprite code in bank 1, one step per animation frame ([$1570] - 1) * 16.

BooBossPals.name: Palette data: Big Boo boss, then $FF padding
summary: 8 rows of 16 bytes (8 colors, BGR555) copied by the Big Boo boss code in bank 3 to fade the boss (transparency effect, palette E); row picked from [$190B]. The rest of the bank up to $03BFFF is $FF padding.

GenTileFromSpr2.name: Generate block at sprite position
summary: Creates a block (map16 tile) at the sprite's position (X - 8, Y + 8) using GenerateTile.
Parameters: A = block number; X = sprite index.
$03C023 (separate routine): long-call wrapper that sets the data bank and runs the Baby Yoshi swallow code at $03C02F; called from bank 2.

s03C02B.name: Table: cycling power-up sprite numbers
summary: Sprite numbers $74 (mushroom), $75 (fire flower), $77 (feather), $76 (star).

s03C02F.name: Baby Yoshi swallows caught sprite
summary: Probably the Baby Yoshi eating code (called through the $03C023 wrapper). Erases the sprite caught by the tongue ([$160E,X]) and plays a sound.
If the eaten sprite is a power-up ($74-$77), or it is the fifth sprite eaten ([$1570]), the sprite becomes a full Yoshi (sprite $35).
Otherwise gives points. Sprite $81 is replaced by a power-up from a table cycled by the frame counter (purpose partly unclear).
Parameters: X = Baby Yoshi sprite index.

s03C0B2.name: Table: animated tiles and phase offsets
summary: Tile numbers $68, $6A, $6C, $6E and 16 per-tile animation phase offsets, for the row drawn by CODE_03C0C6.

s03C0C6.name: Iggy/Larry room: draw row and tilt platform
summary: Called from bank 0 (non-Mode 7 boss room path). Updates the tilting platform unless sprites are locked, then draws 20 16x16 tiles across the screen at Y = $C4 (probably the lava), OAM slots $6C-$7F, animated from the frame counter.
Quirk: the phase offset loop reads 4 bytes past DATA_03C0B6 (into code), only the low two bits are used.

IggyPlatSpeed.name: Table: platform tilt speed
summary: Low byte (-1, +1, -1, +1) and sign-extension byte of the tilt change per step, indexed by the tilt direction (+2 for steep phases).

IggyPlatBounds.name: Iggy/Larry platform tilt update
summary: Tilts the platform one step every other frame by adding a speed to [$36]/[$37] until it hits the maximum, then holds still for $40 frames and advances the phase.
[$1905] = number of tilts made, [$1906] = hold timer, [$1907] = phase 0-5 (phases 4 and 5 tilt further).
Data at $03C11A: maximum tilt values. Code at $03C11E returns at once if sprites are locked or the battle is over ([$1493]).

s03C176.name: Table: Yoshi tongue tip X offsets
summary: 40 bytes of X offsets of the tongue tip tile (index [$02] from tongue phase, direction and head frame); used by the Yoshi graphics code in bank 1.

s03C19E.name: Table: Yoshi tongue tip Y offsets
summary: 40 bytes of Y offsets for the same tongue tip tile.

s03C1C6.name: Table: slope nudge for sprites
summary: X low bytes +2/-2 and X high bytes $00/$FF, indexed by slope direction.

s03C1CA.name: Move sprite along a slope
summary: Long-call routine from bank 1 (sprites on slopes such as the Diggin' Chuck rock and the football). Nudges the sprite X by +2 or -2 depending on the slope sign in [$15B8,X] and sets Y speed to $18 so it stays on the slope.
Parameters: X = sprite index.

s03C1EC.name: Table: light switch Y shake
summary: Screen Y offsets applied while the switch is drawn, indexed by hit timer / 2.

LightSwitch.name: Light switch sprite main
summary: Sprite $C8. Behaves as a solid block (InvisBlkMainRt) and despawns off-screen. When the hit timer [$1558] reaches 5 it toggles bit 0 of the state of every normal Dark Room (sprite $C6) in the 10 first slots.
Graphics: draws generic sprite tile $2A, temporarily shifting the screen Y by a table value for a press animation.
Parameters: X = sprite index.

ChainsawMotorTiles.name: Table: chainsaw tiles and setup
summary: Motor animation tiles, per-sprite blade segment Y spacing ($65 and $66) and blade properties. Code at $03C263 is a long-call wrapper (data bank = $03) around ChainsawGfx, called from bank 1.

ChainsawGfx.name: Draw chainsaw
summary: Draws three 16x16 tiles: an animated motor and two blade tiles that jitter every other frame. Sprite $65 draws the blade above, $66 below (Y flipped).
Parameters: X = sprite index.

TriggerInivis1Up.name: Spawn 1-Up if a sprite slot is free
summary: Long routine called from bank 0 when the hidden 1-Up counter ([$1421]) reaches 4. Searches slots $0B-$00 for a free one; if found, continues into Generate1Up.

Generate1Up.name: Create 1-Up mushroom at Mario
summary: Makes sprite X a normal 1-Up mushroom ($78) at Mario's position, initializes it, sets the interaction disable timer and pops it out (PopupMushroom). Returns long.

InvisMushroom.name: Invisible mushroom sprite main
summary: Sprite $C7. When Mario touches it, becomes a mushroom ($74) a bit higher and falls into PopupMushroom.

PopupMushroom.name: Pop item upward
summary: Sets the sprite direction from Mario's X speed (left = 1), Y speed $C0 (up) and plays sound $02. Used when a mushroom or 1-Up appears.
